item.title: Immigration and Asylum Bill passes third reading in Commons
item.body: The Immigration and Asylum Bill, which underpins the Home Secretary's immigration reforms, has passed its third reading in the House of Commons. It is the latest hurdle the legislation has cleared.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ⚖️ Immigration and Asylum Bill passes third reading in Commons

The Immigration and Asylum Bill, which underpins the Home Secretary's immigration reforms, has passed its third reading in the House of Commons. It is the latest hurdle the legislation has cleared.

Source: GOV.UK Home Office | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 18 November, 12:50
